title: Animated Tooltip
description: Avatar row with springy name tooltips on hover.

a11y.motion: The tooltip appears and disappears instantly instead of springing in, and the avatar's hover scale no longer transitions.
a11y.keyboard: Each avatar is focusable with Tab and shows its tooltip and a focus ring while focused; Escape hides the tooltip.
a11y.screenReader: Each avatar is read as its name and role from visually hidden text; the visual tooltip and initials are aria-hidden.
